svg.title: PSX3D performance
svg.text: GPU renderer, each game's heaviest tested scene. Game speed = how fast the game runs (100% = normal). FPS = new pictures you actually see per second.
Dashed line = the most pictures per second the game itself draws (most PS1 3D games draw 30).
Auto frameskip trades pictures for game speed: it skips drawing some pictures to help the game run faster.
